name: Ada
source:
Occupation: Roman's right hand man
Likes: Contortion, foggy weather, silence
Dislikes: Anyone but Roman, being touched

Ada, Roman's most devout assassin and, as some call him, 'The Silent Hound', will always kill first and never ask questions later. He does what he is instructed to do without fault and without hesitation. Further information is virtually impossible to find. He is extremely dangerous, do not engage.
